name: Mine Sweep
hook: One huge minefield. Clear it as a team.
how: Everyone digs the same field at once, and you can see each other's cursors. Numbers tell you how many mines touch a square: flag the mines, dig the rest. Every boom costs the team one of three lives. Clear the field fast to get on the board.
controls: Click to dig, right-click to flag, click a number to dig around it; on touch, tap to dig, long-press to flag (or switch with the Dig/Flag button), pinch to zoom
uses: The host's browser places the mines and checks every dig; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot sweepers dig and flag alongside you when the room is quiet.
Everyone's cursor, flag and dig shows up for the whole team.
The owner can change the mine count and lives without a new deploy.
ideas: Make it a snowy field with buried presents instead of mines
Add a power-up square that shows three mines for ten seconds
Give each player their own score for safe digs
